block.create_ai.brass_mechanical_saw.too: Processes items at twice the speed of a _Mechanical Saw_, and fells trees twice as fast or with _Silk Touch_.
Mode selected on the top face
_Fast Tree Felling_ breaks blocks at double speed. _Precision_ cuts at a _Mechanical Saw_'s speed but fells trees with _Silk Touch_, so leaves drop as leaves.
block.create_ai.processing_table.tooltip: A workbench for laying a recipe out by hand: spread the ingredients on its face, then assemble them cell by cell with a _Wrench_.
When an item is held against it
The item goes into the middle of the table; a bare hand takes the middle item back.
The whole layout is pushed one cell the way the clicked half of the face points, as the _Movement Mode_ button on the sides says.
When a _Wrench_ is held against it
One ingredient is installed, and the product appears in the middle of the table once the last one is in. A layout that matches nothing warns first, and one more click empties the table.
The _Movement Mode_ is switched on the table's _sides_.
item.create_ai.hammer.tooltip.condition3: Sneak and use on a Depot
item.create_ai.hammer.tooltip.behaviour3: Mills one item on it, as a _Millstone_ would.
item.create_ai.obsidian_hammer.tooltip.s: A _Hammer_ that also stands in for _Crushing Wheels_.
item.create_ai.obsidian_hammer.tooltip.c: Sneak and use on a Depot
item.create_ai.obsidian_hammer.tooltip.b: Crushes one item on it, as _Crushing Wheels_ would.
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.summary: Stands in for a _Spout_ on a Depot.
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.behavio: Fills what the Depot holds, as a Spout does.
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.conditi: Used on fluid or a Fluid Tank
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.behavio: Draws the fluid into the tank.
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.conditi: A fluid-filled item right-clicked onto it
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.behavio: Fills the gun from that item.
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.conditi: An empty bucket right-clicked onto it
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.behavio: Fills the bucket from the gun.
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.conditi: Sneak and held use on a fluid container
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.behavio: Pours the chosen amount into it.
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.conditi: An empty cursor right-clicked onto it in an inventory
item.create_ai.spout_gun.tooltip.behavio: Steps to the next _Transfer_ amount, shown under the crosshair.
item.create_ai.spout_gun.purge_hint: Held use aimed at nothing empties it
item.create_ai.stirring_rod.tooltip.beha: Stirs what the Basin holds, as a Mixer does.
item.create_ai.handheld_encased_fan.tool: The air of an _Encased Fan_, aimed by looking.
While the use key is held
Blows along the way you look, four blocks of it.
With a fan-processing block in the flow
Processes what the air carries, as a fan does.
Pushes the entities around you away.
item.create_ai.handheld_encased_fan.nozz: Nozzle: pushes everything around you away, and processes nothing
item.create_ai.handheld_mechanical_saw.t: Stands in for a _Mechanical Saw_ on a Depot.
Cuts what the Depot holds, as a Saw does, once per second.
Cuts only what the filter selects, and cycles through its outputs.
A filter right-clicked onto it in an inventory
Goes into the filter slot; right-click again empty-handed to take it back out.
Cuts the entity, dealing damage and slowing it.
item.create_ai.goggles.tooltip.summary: Stands in for a pair of _Goggles_, and lets you work with the precision of a _Deployer_.
item.create_ai.goggles.tooltip.behaviour: Shows a machine's speed, its contents and its recipes, as _Goggles_ do.
item.create_ai.goggles.tooltip.condition: Sneak and use on a Depot holding an item
item.create_ai.goggles.tooltip.behaviour: Installs the item in hand onto it, as a _Deployer_ would, spending one.
create_ai.processing_table.no_recipe: Nothing here matches a recipe — one more wrench click empties the table
